Respects max body size limit and truncates or skips oversized pages

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"max_body_size\":1024,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
print(result)
```
